units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:8">B. Bath. V, 8</cite>, a. e. <he>הִרְכִּינָהּ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M02271"><he>מָצָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14">Num. R. s. 14<sup>7</sup></cite> <he>הוא לא ה׳ צוארו לעבירה וכ׳</he> he (Joseph) bent not his neck (did not yield) to temptation, therefore a golden chain was put on his neck; Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Genesis 12">B’resh. 12</cite> <he>צואר שלא ה׳ וכ׳</he> the neck which did not bend &c.; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 23:9">Lev. R. s. 23</cite> <he>שלא הִרִכִּינוֹ</he> which he did not bend.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10">Num. R. s. 10<sup>7</sup></cite> <he>והִרְכַּנְתִּי את ראשי</he> I bent my head (nodding approval); Y. Ned. I, 36ᵈ bot. <he>והרכנתיו בראשי</he> (read <he>והרכנתי</he>); <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 22:1">Sifré Num. 22</cite> (not <he>גלחתי</he>); (<cite ref="Tosefta Nazir 4:7">Tosef. Naz. IV, 7</cite> <he>הֵימַכְתִּי</he>). Y. Ter. I, 40ᵇ top <he>ה׳ בראשו</he> if he nodded consent; <cite ref="Yoma 2a">ib.</cite> <he>עד שיַרְכִּין וכ׳</he> until he nods three times.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65:20">Gen. R. s. 65</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 27:22">Gen. XXVII, 22</cite>) <he>בשעה שיעקב מַרְכִּין בקולו וכ׳</he> when Jacob is faint with his voice (in prayer), Esau’s hands have power over him, opp. <he>מצפצף</he>.
